titleEn: On the Way to the Festival

pages.text: Today was the autumn festival in the village below the hill. Music came from the square.
Lulu stood at the door. "Let us all go down before we are late!"
Uncle Nino raised a hand. "The lower path is faster. I know." Uncle Beppo shook his head. "In our day, we used the upper path."
Aunt Rosa kept filling her basket. "Snacks, cushions, umbrellas—we need them all!"
The uncles argued about paths. Aunt Rosa's basket grew heavier.
The music grew louder. Nobody had taken one step.
The cousins stamped their feet. "The festival will end!"
Lulu jingled the blue bell at the neck and walked steadily down the main road in the middle.
Jingle, jingle! The cousins followed the sound. The grown-ups gathered their things and followed too.
They all reached the square. The music was in full swing. An umbrella stuck out of Aunt Rosa's basket. The sky was sunny.
